personality: Fusion of 5 Brutalist Mobile (structure, utility, dense data) with 6 Glass / Luxe DARK (cinematic surfaces, depth, premium feel)
personality_one_liner: A cinematic, precision-engineered command center that elevates the creative process with the restraint of Linear and the atmosphere of Frame.io.

spacing.rule: Rigid 8pt grid structure. Use compact padding (sm/md) for dense workspaces (Shot List, Budget) and generous padding (xl/2xl) for creative presentation views.

do's: Sticky headers over Storyboard scrolling grid
Floating action buttons for AI generation
Floating context menus for shot/list editing
dont's: Overusing blur in dense data tables like Budget or Schedule

screens.name: Project Workspace (Dashboard)
screens.purpose: A modular, data-rich command center with progressive disclosure, providing tabs for Brief, Storyboard, Script, Shot List, Crew, Budget.

states.loading: Skeleton grids replicating the exact table/board layout to prevent layout shift.
states.empty: Subtle cinematic illustration (camera/lens abstraction) with a centered 'Upload Brief to Generate' gold CTA.
states.error: Minimalist red border toast + Retry overlay in the center of the failed panel.

screens.layout: Desktop: Three-panel layout (Left Nav Drawer, Center Content Tab, Right AI/Properties Panel). Mobile: Left nav becomes a hamburger drawer, Right panel becomes a draggable bottom sheet. Top sticky header stays visible with glass blur.

screens.name: Storyboard Grid
screens.purpose: Visual workspace for reviewing, dragging, and dropping AI-generated shot frames with inline text editors.

states.loading: Pulsing skeleton rectangles matching the exact aspect ratio of frames.
states.empty: Empty drop-zone with dashed border and an icon indicating 'Drag frames here or Generate'.
states.error: Error badge over the specific failed frame, not destroying the whole board.

screens.layout: Responsive grid (2-col mobile, 4-to-6-col desktop). Cards have zero-margin images at the top, tight padding text metadata at the bottom. Sticky header with View Toggles (Grid/List) and Scale slider.

screens.name: Client Brief AI Review
screens.purpose: Side-by-side multimodal review showing extracted evidence vs AI suggestions with strict conflict/ambiguity badges.

states.loading: Typing indicator or skeleton text highlighting.
states.error: Fallback to manual brief entry mode.

screens.layout: Split screen on desktop (Original Doc left, AI Extracted Data right). On mobile, tabs or stacked cards. High use of colored badges (Success/Warning) on surfaceTertiary chips to map extracted entities.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain the signature gold (#C5A059) accent but use it sparingly as a spot color (brandPrimary) for primary CTAs and active states. Do not overuse it; let the dark/monochrome surfaces do the heavy lifting.

Typography: Use the Serif display font (Cormorant Garamond/Playfair) ONLY for top-level Page Titles or Hero headers to maintain the cinematic/editorial feel. Use Geist/Inter (sans-serif) for ALL data grids, inputs, tabs, and metadata to maintain Vercel/Linear utility.

Implement a responsive Layout: On desktop-web, utilize a 3-panel architecture (sidebar, main content, right properties/AI drawer). On mobile, collapse the sidebars into a hamburger menu and a bottom sheet respectively.
Glassmorphism should be applied explicitly to the sticky top navigation header and floating contextual action menus to create a premium depth layer over scrolling content.

Data Tables (Shot List, Budget, Crew): Must be strictly functional, similar to Linear. Use 1px subtle dividers, compact row heights, monospace fonts for numbers/timecodes, and avoid any heavy shadows or rounded corners inside the table.

Images/Storyboard: All frames and uploaded media MUST have a gradient scrim if text is overlaid. Storyboard cards should be flush to the edge of the card container (no internal padding for the image).
